checks.retry_wording: None of the four zh-CN values says 重试/再试, as the en context notes require (no Retry control beside the row).
checks.discard_term: 丢弃 is the locale's word for throwing a thing away: ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_verb 已丢弃, ui.teamBridge.holds Discard 丢弃 (deletes the message). 放弃 is used where the object is unsaved edits or a draft label (ui.settings.*.discard*, ui.chat.sidebar.drafts.discard_label). A kept recording being thrown away matches the 丢弃 family; button, 请丢弃它 and 丢弃录音 all use the same verb.
checks.clipped_join: dictation_refused_take_kept_clipped joins {reason} and the next sentence with a half-width space and no full stop, exactly like en and like sibling dictation_unknown_clipped, as the en context note requires.
checks.width: Button is two characters, next to 重试 (also two).

findings.current: 听写失败：{reason}。丢弃录音，或连同应用日志一起报告此问题。
findings.proposed: 听写失败：{reason}。请丢弃录音，或连同应用日志一起报告此问题。
findings.reason: The zh-CN style guide binds 请 on the first next-step clause of an error body (a refusal body that tells the reader what to do), not a bare imperative. The sibling too_long key in ui.chat.composer already carries it (请丢弃它并……) for the same Discard action, so the same instruction reads curt here. Minor, not major: the style guide says existing values predate the rule and neighbours dictation_unknown / dictation_no_reason are also bare (重试，或……), so the namespace's established house voice is bare; the fix is optional for the row and mandatory only if the sibling values are swept.
